statement.notes: 1. 'Sales revenue' mapped to 'revenue'. 2. 'total_operating_cost' calculated as: Cost of sales + Distribution expenses + Administrative expenses + Other operating expenses - Other operating income. This aligns with the standard calculation of total operating costs (operating expenses) as the sum of costs and expenses minus other operating income, which is a common adjustment. 3. 'Net income' mapped to 'Earnings after tax'. 4. 'Taxes' mapped to 'Income tax income/expense' (absolute expense value). 5. 'Interest expenses' taken directly from the line item. All values are in € million as per the statement.
